h: Uganda restricts transit for travellers from DR Congo as it investigates an Ebola case
p: Uganda has barred travellers with recent DR Congo travel history from passing through the country while health officials investigate an Ebola case. The measure is meant to limit spread across the border. Neighbouring countries are on alert.
more: Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in Abuja this week.
Health officials in the region are tracing contacts.
Travel advisories are expected to be updated.
